# rasuvaeff/yii3-workflow

Compact API reference for LLM coding assistants.

## Install

```
composer require rasuvaeff/yii3-workflow
```

## Rules

- This package does NOT implement a state machine: `symfony/workflow` does. It
  supplies the Yii3 wiring plus a transition history and idempotency, which the
  component leaves out.
- Workflows come from the container: `WorkflowRegistry::get('order')`. They are
  built lazily, so a broken definition fails on first use, not at boot.
- `WorkflowRegistry::get()` returns an `IdempotentWorkflow` decorator, NOT a
  `Symfony\Component\Workflow\WorkflowInterface` (that interface changed between
  Symfony 6.4 and 8.x). Use `->workflow()` to reach the raw one.
- Guards and reactions are plain PSR-14 listeners on the workflow event classes
  (`GuardEvent`, `CompletedEvent`, …), registered wherever the app registers
  listeners. The package requires the event-dispatcher CONTRACTS only.
- Each workflow event reaches the PSR-14 dispatcher exactly ONCE (on the generic
  name), not once per `workflow.<name>.<event>` variant — narrow inside the
  listener with `getWorkflowName()` and `getTransition()`.
- `TransitionLog` is intentionally not bound by the package: exactly one source
  (the application or a backend package, e.g. rasuvaeff/yii3-workflow-db) may
  bind it. Without a binding the workflows run but record nothing, and passing
  an idempotency key throws a LogicException instead of pretending to protect.
- `applyOnce()` refuses a key its wiring cannot honour with a LogicException:
  no TransitionLog, no IdempotencyContext, or (detected after the transition)
  no AuditListener recorded the key. Build workflows via WorkflowFactory so the
  wiring is consistent.
- A key is scoped to (workflow, subject), NOT to a transition: reusing a key on
  the same subject with a different transition returns false (replay). Keys
  must be unique per operation.
- `TransitionLog::append()` MUST throw `DuplicateIdempotencyKey` when the
  (workflow, subject, key) triple already exists — a storage backend should back
  that with a unique constraint. `applyOnce()` catches it and returns false: the
  subject is already mutated in memory, so wrap the call in a transaction.
- A subject needs `SubjectIdentity` to be audited or to use an idempotency key.
- In a `state_machine`, `from: [a, b]` is expanded into one transition per
  source; a transition with two targets is a configuration error (Symfony's
  `StateMachineValidator` runs when the workflow is built).
- Places and endpoints accept backed enums or strings.
- `EnumMarkingStore` reads and writes a private/protected enum property; use
  `['type' => 'method']` for classic `getX()`/`setX()` subjects. Reading rejects
  any value that is not a case of the configured enum class.

## Configuration (params.php)

```php
'rasuvaeff/yii3-workflow' => [
    'workflows' => [
        'order' => [
            'type' => 'state_machine',        // or 'workflow' (Petri net)
            'initial' => OrderStatus::Pending,
            'places' => OrderStatus::cases(), // strings or backed enums
            'markingStore' => [
                'type' => 'enum',             // 'enum' | 'method' | a MarkingStoreInterface
                'enum' => OrderStatus::class,
                'property' => 'status',
            ],
            'transitions' => [
                ['name' => 'pay', 'from' => OrderStatus::Pending, 'to' => OrderStatus::Paid],
                ['name' => 'cancel', 'from' => [OrderStatus::Pending, OrderStatus::Paid], 'to' => OrderStatus::Cancelled,
                 'metadata' => ['label' => 'Cancel the order']],   // optional, per transition
            ],
            'metadata' => ['title' => 'Order flow'],               // optional, workflow-level
            'placesMetadata' => ['paid' => ['bg_color' => 'x']],   // optional, keyed by place NAME (string);
                                                                   // unknown place = error
        ],
    ],
],
```

## API reference

### WorkflowRegistry

```php
final class WorkflowRegistry
{
    public function __construct(array $definitions, WorkflowFactory $factory);
    public function get(string $name): IdempotentWorkflow;   // built once, cached
    public function has(string $name): bool;
    public function names(): array;                          // list<string>
}
```

### IdempotentWorkflow

```php
final readonly class IdempotentWorkflow
{
    public function __construct(
        WorkflowInterface $workflow,
        ?TransitionLog $log = null,
        ?IdempotencyContext $idempotency = null,
        ?PsrEventDispatcherInterface $dispatcher = null,   // receives TransitionReplayed
    );

    /** @return bool false = the key was already applied, nothing happened */
    public function applyOnce(object $subject, string $transition, ?string $idempotencyKey = null, array $context = []): bool;

    public function apply(object $subject, string $transition, array $context = []): Marking;
    public function can(object $subject, string $transition): bool;
    public function blockers(object $subject, string $transition): TransitionBlockerList;
    public function enabledTransitions(object $subject): iterable;   // iterable<Transition>
    public function name(): string;
    public function definition(): Definition;
    public function workflow(): WorkflowInterface;
}
```

### WorkflowFactory

```php
final readonly class WorkflowFactory
{
    public function __construct(
        ClockInterface $clock,
        ?PsrEventDispatcherInterface $dispatcher = null,
        ?TransitionLog $log = null,
        ?IdempotencyContext $idempotency = null,
    );

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $definition */
    public function create(string $name, array $definition): IdempotentWorkflow;
}
```

### Marking store, identity, dispatcher

```php
final readonly class EnumMarkingStore implements MarkingStoreInterface
{
    /** @param class-string<\BackedEnum> $enum */
    public function __construct(string $enum, string $property = 'status');
}

interface SubjectIdentity
{
    public function workflowSubjectId(): string;
}

// Guard base: extend it and the "is this my workflow / my transition" filter is done.
abstract class TransitionGuard
{
    final public function __invoke(object $event): void;      // register as a PSR-14 listener
    abstract protected function workflow(): string;
    protected function transitions(): array;                  // list<string>; [] = every transition
    abstract protected function guard(GuardEvent $event): void;
}

final readonly class WorkflowEventDispatcher implements \Symfony\Contracts\EventDispatcher\EventDispatcherInterface
{
    /** @param iterable<callable(object): void> $listeners internal listeners, run before the app's */
    public function __construct(?PsrEventDispatcherInterface $psrDispatcher = null, iterable $listeners = []);
}
```

### Audit

```php
namespace Rasuvaeff\Yii3Workflow\Audit;

interface TransitionLog
{
    /** @throws DuplicateIdempotencyKey when this (workflow, subject, key) is already stored */
    public function append(TransitionRecord $record): void;
    public function forSubject(string $workflow, string $subjectId): array;   // list<TransitionRecord>
    public function hasIdempotencyKey(string $workflow, string $subjectId, string $key): bool;
}

final readonly class TransitionRecord
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $workflow,
        public string $subjectId,
        public string $transition,
        public string $from,
        public string $to,
        public \DateTimeImmutable $at,
        public ?string $idempotencyKey = null,
    );

    public function toArray(): array;
}

final class InMemoryTransitionLog implements TransitionLog { public function all(): array; }

// Dispatched to the app's PSR-14 dispatcher on every skipped replay.
final readonly class TransitionReplayed
{
    public string $workflow;
    public string $subjectId;
    public string $transition;
    public string $idempotencyKey;
    public bool $storageDecided;   // false = pre-flight lookup, true = unique constraint decided a race
}

final readonly class AuditListener   // PSR-14 listener on CompletedEvent
{
    public function __construct(TransitionLog $log, ClockInterface $clock, IdempotencyContext $idempotency);
    public function __invoke(object $event): void;
}

final class DuplicateIdempotencyKey extends \RuntimeException
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly string $workflow,
        public readonly string $subjectId,
        public readonly string $idempotencyKey,
        ?\Throwable $previous = null,
    );
}

final class IdempotencyContext
{
    public function current(): ?string;
    public function during(?string $key, callable $operation): mixed;
}
```

### Console — `Command\WorkflowDumpCommand`

```
./yii workflow:dump                       # list configured workflows
./yii workflow:dump order                 # mermaid (default)
./yii workflow:dump order --format=puml   # plantuml
./yii workflow:dump order --format=dot    # graphviz
```

The diagram flavour follows the configured `type`: a `state_machine` is drawn
with direct edges, a Petri-net `workflow` with explicit transition nodes.

## Minimal example

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Workflow\WorkflowRegistry;

$workflow = $registry->get('order');

if (!$workflow->applyOnce($order, 'ship', idempotencyKey: $requestId)) {
    return;   // replay of the same request
}

foreach ($workflow->blockers($order, 'cancel') as $blocker) {
    echo $blocker->getMessage(), ' ', $blocker->getCode();
}
```
